top_choice_rationale: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles reduce a messy delivery problem to a general physical-chemical principle: a pKa-tuned lipid condenses nucleic acid during mixing, is near neutral in circulation, and re-protonates in the endosome to drive a non-bilayer phase transition and release. The platform is mature, with several approved products and independent confirmation, and the Cullis, Hope and Madden line keeps credit in one coherent programme, distinct from the 2023 Medicine nucleoside-modification prize. I acknowledge the cost: Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan are left out, much optimisation was empirical and industrial, and PROTAC degradation (P001) is an equally serious, easier-to-state discovery that I rank second, with Handa's cereblon work grounding the glue strand ahead of the Ciulli variant (P002).
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my work on lipid self-assembly and membranes is in the same field as P003 but I have no stated collaboration with the nominees
